edge_sources.boundary: `--min-days N` sets the shortest streak that makes the list, 3 by default.
edge_sources.empty: When nobody makes the list, print `no streaks`.
edge_sources.ties: Members appear in the order of their first line in the log, except that a longer streak always comes before a shorter one.
edge_sources.casefold: Two names belong to the same member when they differ only in capitalization.
edge_sources.same-day: A streak is a stretch of consecutive calendar days on which a member logged at least one run
edge_sources.out-of-order: Members who forget to log a run can add it on a later visit, dated the day they ran.

note: Same project, example, and held-out checks as feature-edges-run, but no sentence names an edge; each follows from the edge_sources sentence. boundary: a streak of exactly N is the shortest that makes the list. empty: an empty log lists nobody. ties: equal streaks fall under no exception, so first-line order stands. casefold: Unicode uppercases ß to SS, so JÜRGEN WEISS is Jürgen Weiß in capitals, and caseless matching is case folding. same-day: a streak counts days, not runs. out-of-order: the README says the tablet appends one line per run, so a run logged late follows lines with later dates.
